sections.text: Soldier head capsule pale orange-yellow. Head length (including mandibles) 2.06 mm, head length (excluding mandibles) 1.54 mm, mandible length 0.75 mm, head width 0.78 mm. Closest to Microcerotermes zuluensis.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule pale orange-yellow. Head length (including mandibles) 2.06 mm; head length (excluding mandibles) 1.54 mm; mandible length 0.75 mm; head width 0.78 mm. Closest to Microcerotermes zuluensis Holmgren. Type locality Luluabourg, Belgian Congo (collected by Callewaert).

note: Adapted from the original description in Sjöstedt (1925) "Neue Termiten aus Afrika und Madagaskar" (Konowia 4: 53–55), original in German; that paper follows the short "n. sp." format, with only 2—5 lines per species, and the original entry for this species gives only the colour of the soldier, 4 measurements, the closest relative and the type locality, without any other morphological description. This entry therefore contains only the diagnostic characters and the soldier; the alate and the worker are not recorded in the original. In the OCR "Mandeln" is an error for "Mandibeln" (mandibles) and has been read according to the sense.
